name: The Grim Reaper who reaped my Heart!
source:
One day, a mysterious and ominous door appeared in your house. You decided to enter it only to find what invaded your home is a cute girl playing with a handheld console, claiming she's a Grim Reaper.

[From [url=https://kamuo.itch.io/vel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天，你家里突然出现了一扇神秘而不祥的门。你决定进去一探究竟，却发现闯入自己家中的竟是一位正玩着掌机的可爱女孩，而她自称是死神。

[摘自[url=https://kamuo.itch.io/vel]Itch.io[/url]]
